tasks.label: stop old dev server
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; for ($i=0; $i -lt 20; $i++) { $pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5009,7015 -State Listen | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if (-not $pids) { break }; foreach ($procId in $pids) { taskkill /T /F /PID $procId | Out-Null }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
